text_block_list.text:
Passing by the dance studio, I saw Dream 
Journey and Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Hello.
choice_data_list: Are you two practicing dance together?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, mostly mine, actually. I asked 
Curren-san if she could give me some 
advice.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Because of my small stature, I tend to 
get buried among the others. If the center 
gets obscured, that would be a problem."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
So, I was hoping you could teach me an 
impressive—an eye-catching dance.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, being chosen by Journey-san is such 
an honor♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And so, here are Curren's "Dance Moves 
That Pop Even If You're Petite"!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
There are many ways to go about it, but 
how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The first method is to make the absolute 
most of your own strengths.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If it's Journey-san, maybe sharp moves and 
cool style?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Number two is appealing to the crowd to 
meet their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fan service, right? If it's Curren, a cute 
smile would be perfect♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, which method do you think suits 
Journey-san better?
choice_data_list: A cool dance that plays to your strengths
A dance packed with cute fan service

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. According to Curren's advice 
earlierâ"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Make each movement larger. And move 
sharply and dynamically, correct?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Would it be something like this?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, amazing! It's so sharp, and I can 
feel the beat even in the quiet 
movements...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So coo~l! It makes Curren's heart skip a 
beat♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san, that's amazing! You did it on 
your first try.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
With this, I don't think there's anything 
left for Curren to teach you, is there?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Expressiveness could be said to be one of 
my weaknesses. I would very much like to 
learn from your rich and multifaceted 
expression, Curren-san.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, really? Just a little bit longer, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Please show me all 
kinds of things, Curren-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Does it suit me? I'm not quite sure 
myself, though...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. However, I am not good at cute 
gestures. Curren-san, could you show me an 
example?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing. I'll dance for you, so watch 
closely!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Here it comes♪ Curren Smile♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: And next~ bang-kyun!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
A cute pose to finish it off! Fall head 
over heels for me♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Phew! That's how it's done. Alright, 
Journey, you're up next!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I see, that was very informative. However, 
all of those choreographies seem 
exceptionally difficult for me...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it will take quite some time 
to truly make it my own.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's not hard at all. Shall we try dancing 
it once?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That's only because of your high level of 
skill, Curren-san. With my dance level, 
it's simply out of the question...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, I got a clear enough picture. 
Thank you very much for the lovely dance, 
Curren-san.
